name: push up and triceps dip on parallel bars
description: A combined move on parallel bars that pairs a push-up with a dip. It works the chest and triceps.
instructions: Place hands on parallel bars and support yourself in a plank.
Lower into a push-up with your elbows out.
Press back up to a plank.
Shift your hands to the edge of the bars, body upright.
Dip down and press up, then repeat the cycle.
